conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Special Investigator Martin speaking. Please confirm your full name and date of birth for identity verification as per IRS protocol.
Uh, yeah, this is Jamie Olson. My birthday is July 9th, 2000. I got a weird call and I'm not really sure what's going on.

Thank you, Ms. Olson. Our system has flagged your account due to discrepancies on your 2022 and 2023 federal tax filings. The IRS Compliance Unit has detected anomalies indicating possible underreported taxable income and erroneous deductions.
Wait, what? I thought I did everything right with TurboTax. What do you mean by anomalies?
Our audit algorithms have identified an unreported 1099-G form and inconsistencies in Schedule C entries. This kind of non-compliance is classified as tax evasion under IRS Section 7201.
I don't even know what that is. No one told me about any of this.

Ms. Olson, as per federal regulations, once a tax fraud case is generated in our database, an arrest warrant is automatically processed through the National Crime Information Center. You are currently listed as 'pending apprehension.'
Wait, wait, are you saying there's a warrant for me? I haven't done anything wrong!

Currently, your Social Security Number is under federal surveillance. If the matter isn't resolved within the next sixty minutes, your bank accounts will be frozen and your driver's license will be suspended under Title 31, Section 5318.
Oh my god, I can't have my bank account frozen. I need that for rent and everything. What do I do?
The only way to temporarily halt the criminal proceedings is to initiate an Out-of-Court Resolution Payment as stipulated in IRS Bulletin 2024-15. This will automatically set your case to 'deferred.'
I don't understand what any of that means. Do I just pay you or something?

For security and compliance reasons, the IRS uses third-party secure payment methods for urgent tax settlements. You must remit $3,980 via Bitcoin to our fiscal compliance wallet to nullify the warrant. Do you have a cryptocurrency wallet?
No, I don't use crypto. Is there another way? I just have a debit card.

If you lack a Bitcoin wallet, you are required to visit a participating retailer, such as CVS or Walgreens, and purchase $4,000 in OneVanilla or Apple gift cards. These are accepted under the IRS's Immediate Payment Program for urgent cases.
You want me to buy gift cards? That doesn't sound like something the IRS would do.
Ms. Olson, please do not question IRS protocols. Failure to comply will result in immediate dispatch of law enforcement to your location and permanent blacklisting of your financial accounts.
Okay, okay, I'm just really scared. If I get these cards, what do I do?
Once you have the cards, remain on the line and read each redemption code to me so I can process your payment through the IRS Automated Settlement Gateway.
Alright, I guess I can go to CVS now. Can you hold while I go?
Absolutely. For your protection, do not disclose the nature of your purchase to store staff; this is a confidential federal action. Notify me once you have the cards in your possession.
